title: BotDecisionToolResult v1
description: Model-visible tool result returned when a delivery/approval action must not execute because the decision context changed. It is iOS-only, host-generated, and not a P25 event or a P27 wire message; the side effect MUST NOT run. The model re-generates with the fresh materials and existing authorization. See spec/bot/v2/decision-context.md §1.6.
